note: Which buses the weekly job pulls. services = route numbers; nocs = operator codes (Stagecoach Cumbria = SCCU). A service with no manifest places is reported as NEW and left out until its places are added.
confirmNote: Buses home need two BODS feeds to agree: a new/changed journey is held as a bus home (j.nh) until a later feed shows it again; times within tolMin minutes count as the same bus. A date where one timetable version says no buses and another says buses holds that service's buses home that day.
signalsNote: Hourly job (signals.mjs). bbox = [south lat, west lon, north lat, east lon] for road incidents. floods = centre + radius km for EA warnings. nh.url = the National Highways feed address from your developer account (key in secret NH_API_KEY); empty = not set up.

signals.roadsNote: Watched roads: a Street Manager CLOSURE whose street/area matches 'match' switches off these bus services + car parks (and every car park within carparkM of the closure point) for the closure dates. Car parks listed here = ones you can only drive to over that road. CHECK the services + add car park names exactly as in the app.
signals.metNote: Met Office Weather DataHub, Site Specific Global Spot hourly (free plan 360 calls/day). Secret MET_API_KEY. Points fetched every everyH hours. Remove-only thresholds — agree them with the owner.
signals.watchPagesNote: Checked once a day for retirement / deprecation notices. 'about' (optional) = only count lines mentioning these words.

floorNote: Fail the run if a service has fewer journeys than this (half the 22 Sep 2026 reference build). Lower a number only after checking the operator timetable.
gapNote: A service below its floor but at or above its gap minimum (default 30% of floor = 15% of the reference size) publishes as a KNOWN GAP (flagged in the app + an issue). Below the gap minimum = the run fails. gapMin overrides the default per service; gapNotes adds a reason shown in the report/issue.

gapNotes.555: Stagecoach's main 555 registration PC0002407/300 is unpublished on BODS (since early Oct 2026); operator emailed 7 Oct.
